_comment: Shared by the C++ strategies (config.hh) and tools/download_data.py, so the data
that gets downloaded cannot drift from the data the strategies open.
coins: traded universe. Every strategy uses this list.
Keep to symbols listed on BOTH Binance spot and USDT-M futures. MATIC (swapped to
POL in 2024-09, and POL has no USDT-M perpetual), XMR (delisted 2024-02) and EOS
are all gone from futures, so data for them cannot be downloaded at all.
history_start: first month to download, 'YYYY-MM'. Futures contracts onboarded from
2019-09 (BTC) onwards, so earlier months simply do not exist for them.
strategies: keyed by each binary's STRAT_NAME constant, NOT its file name -- that is
the string config.hh looks up. 'market' is spot or futures; 'htf' is the higher
timeframe for multi-timeframe strategies. A strategy with no entry here aborts at
max_open_trades sweeps are clamped to the number of coins at runtime: sweeping 'up
to 10 concurrent positions' across 2 pairs is the same backtest ten times.
